parsed.rationale: Both `_DequeStorage._growIfNeeded` (line 334) and `_DequeStorage._shrinkIfNeeded` (line 354) live in the same file `Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Deque.swift` and are structurally similar (Jaccard 0.71), but they encode intentionally opposite capacity-management operations on a deque's backing storage: one expands allocation when the buffer is too small, the other contracts it when the buffer is too large. Despite their near-duplicate shape, merging or abstracting them would obscure the directional semantics that are essential to correct amortized-resize behaviour. The `fields_or_signature` lists are both empty, so there is no shared method surface to extract into a common helper without inspecting the bodies, and the cluster provides no body evidence to ground a safe refactor. Preferring no-action is the conservative choice here.
